page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9ae.large is a general-purpose virtual machine deployed on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T95 processor operating at 2.25 GHz and provides 2 dedicated vCPUs. The hardware profile includes 8.0 GB of system memory, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance operates without GPU accelerators.

Storage and networking configurations are structured for network-attached decoupling. The instance contains no local drive storage, requiring external cloud disks for file systems and runtime data. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 2 Gbps, and the configuration allocates zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses by default.

The 1:4 resource allocation balances compute power and memory capacity, avoiding the overhead of bundled physical storage or specialized GPU acceleration. This provides cost-effective efficiency for low-footprint workloads. The instance is suited for lightweight web serving, application middleware, microservices, background job scheduling, and basic development or staging environments.
